description: If \(T\) implicitly defines its new relation, finite subsets \(\Gamma,\Delta\subseteq T\) already have renamed union entailing agreement of the two copies.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.finite_witnesses.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  {T : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Theory}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.Implicit T) :
  ∃ Γ Δ,
    ↑Γ ⊆ T ∧
      ↑Δ ⊆ T ∧
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side false).onTheory ↑Γ ∪
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side true).onTheory ↑Δ ⊨ᵇ
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.agreement
